name: ascent
description: Ascent: a habit tracker through which you live a year-long story on a mountain route.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run artifact
scripts.build:feel3d: tsc --noEmit && vite build --config vite.feel3d.config.ts && node tools/artifactize.mjs dist/feel-3d/prototypes/feel-3d.html dist/feel-3d/ascent-feel-3d.html
scripts.build:silhouette: tsc --noEmit && vite build --config vite.silhouette.config.ts && node tools/artifactize.mjs dist/feel-silhouette/prototypes/feel-silhouette.html dist/feel-silhouette/ascent-feel-silhouette.html
scripts.build:syncprobe: tsc --noEmit && vite build --config vite.syncprobe.config.ts && node tools/artifactize.mjs dist/sync-probe/prototypes/sync-probe.html dist/sync-probe/ascent-sync-probe.html
